scope: Independent internal before-values challenge of at most two new useful computable native EMC empirical questions selected by single_cell. No new source retrieval, source title search, matrices or gene/phenotype outcome mining.
fixed_review_fields: Specific practical use and primary prior-art difference
Actually authenticated all-EMC observations and available processed measurement coverage
Valid units, assay and exact donor/condition/comparator design
Batch, mixture, handling, overlapping donor and prior exposure alternatives
Prospective question, statistic, uncertainty, strongest alternative and disproof
Reconciliation of known decisions; source gate failure is not all possible analyses exhaustion
candidate_selection: Await owner exact proposals and source/decision bindings; do not generate replacement panels, gene lists, new clock/RNA/IR/APA failure rescues or invented negative hypotheses. At most two candidates; zero viable candidates is an allowed scoped outcome.
numerical_stage: OFF. Requires an exact worthwhile prospective plan and integrating lead review before new values.
RNA_standard: A useful descriptive RNA disease comparison may be sufficient with honest biological and assay limits; protein/functional evidence is not a universal prerequisite.
immutable_scope: Original IG, methylation, MRI, oxygen, IVIM, dynamic, culture fidelity, GSE9309 and DLK1 freezes preserved. TMEM266/DLK1/R8 panels remain shelved. Denied task contents remain denied.
